info.title: HQBase Mail API
info.description: Stable v2 mail API for HQBase clients, automations, and agents. Additive fields may be introduced within v2; clients must ignore unknown response fields. Administrative APIs are not part of this contract.

403.description: Insufficient OAuth scope or mailbox access

404.description: Resource not found or not visible

get.description: Opens an authenticated wake-only WebSocket. The server sends `changed` frames for messages, mailboxes, and permitted drafts. Frames contain no mail data or cursors. After a frame or reconnect, read the authoritative REST resources and change journals. OAuth tokens require `mail:read`; draft frames also require `mail:send`. The authorization decision at upgrade is an event-delivery lease for 10 minutes. Credential or session revocation does not close the current socket immediately. The server closes the socket when the lease ends, and reconnection must use current credentials and permissions.

parameters.name: Upgrade
parameters.description: WebSocket upgrade request.

get.description: Returns a bounded page of message upserts and deletion tombstones in journal order. A request without a cursor returns an empty checkpoint at the current high-water sequence.

200.description: A bounded page of message changes.

400.description: Invalid request. `INVALID_LIMIT` when limit is not an integer from 1 to 100. `INVALID_CHANGE_CURSOR` when the cursor is malformed, foreign, or beyond the current journal. `INVALID_CHANGE_FILTER` when a mailbox, folder, or search filter is supplied.

403.description: Insufficient OAuth scope

410.description: `CHANGE_CURSOR_EXPIRED` when future journal retention removes a required range. The client must start a new full bootstrap.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a checkpoint or previous changes page. Omit it only to create a new checkpoint.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of journal entries read for this page.

get.description: Returns a bounded page of private draft upserts and deletion tombstones in journal order. A request without a cursor returns an empty checkpoint at the current user-specific high-water sequence.

200.description: A bounded page of draft changes.

400.description: Invalid request. `INVALID_LIMIT` when limit is not an integer from 1 to 100. `INVALID_DRAFT_CHANGE_CURSOR` when the cursor is malformed, foreign, or beyond the user's current journal. `INVALID_DRAFT_CHANGE_FILTER` when a mailbox, folder, search, or timestamp filter is supplied.

403.description: Insufficient OAuth scope or mailbox access

410.description: `DRAFT_CHANGE_CURSOR_EXPIRED` when future journal retention removes a required range. The client must start a new full draft bootstrap.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a draft checkpoint or previous draft-changes page. Omit it only to create a new checkpoint.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of draft journal entries read for this page.

cookieSession.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieSession.description: Same-origin HQBase web session. Secure deployments may prefix the cookie name.

agentBearer.description: Mailbox agent credential created in Settings > Agents. It works only for the assigned Mail API capabilities and mailbox grant. Each operation lists required capabilities in x-hqbase-agent-capabilities.

kind.description: Whether this is an ordinary mailbox or a dedicated mailbox created with a mailbox agent.

deletedAt.description: Deletion time. Normal Mail API lists return null because deleted mailboxes are hidden.

folder.description: Stored message folder. Drafts use the separate Draft schema and endpoints; current write paths do not produce message summaries with `folder: drafts`.

labels.description: Labels assigned to this message. Conversation summaries contain the union from accessible messages.

mailboxId.description: The mailbox at deletion, or null for owner-only unassigned mail.

afterQuotedHtml.description: Sanitized authored content that follows quoted reply history, or null when absent.
